text: American ballet student Suzy Bannion arrives at a Freiburg dance academy just as another girl flees its doors in terror. Inside, maggots rain from the ceiling, a blind pianist's dog turns on him, and a headmistress said to be away [rasps for breath behind a curtain|images|sounds, smells and silence]. Suzy learns the school was founded by [a Greek émigrée said to be a witch|threat|witchcraft and cursed things], and that [a coven dies with its leader|rules|it has a fatal weakness]. A blue iris on a mural opens the corridor where [the teachers plan her sacrifice|wants|the sacrifice demanded].
